title: Orientation Before Action
current_claim: When consequence matters, establish a provisional heading, make a bounded move, let reality answer, record the delta, and reorient from where you actually arrived.

doors.story: A competent loop can improve yesterday's problem forever.
doors.theory: Orientation is a provisional vector, not a permanent destination.
doors.field: One bounded change with a real aperture for surprise.
doors.return: A revised heading grounded in observed delta.

game_action.rule: Generation alone does not count as world-contact.
